svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 8.67k stars in total, about 1.1k a year earlier, mostly from tools launched since then. mr boxington 506, aube 2028, fnox 2275, hk 1265, pitchfork 685, usage 1057, +6 more 853.
